label: Local gate guard
note: The locals' guard on the front gate posts while they hold the barracks (territory.json "barracks"). Runs the front gate checkpoint exactly like the Remnant's gate guards: same place, same bands, papers, search, bribes and barks, on your standing with the locals. It takes the checkpoint rules from local_guard.json (checkpoint_of: one set of gate rules for whoever holds the gate). Only the blocks below differ from local_guard.json.
